definitions.gloss: transcendent; extraordinary; far surpassing the ordinary
definitions.explanation: Describes something that goes far beyond normal levels. Used both in formal/literary contexts and in casual modern speech as an intensifier.

examples.japanese: {超絶|ちょうぜつ}⟦{技巧|ぎこう}→技巧：12779_gikou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ピアニスト→ピアニスト：19413_pianisuto⟧。
⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ラーメン→ラーメン：05181_raamen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{超絶|ちょうぜつ}⟦うまい→うまい：01279_umai⟧。
examples.english: The ramen at that place is insanely good.

examples.japanese: {超絶|ちょうぜつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{演奏|えんそう}{技術|ぎじゅつ}→演奏技術：26542_ensougijutsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{魅了|みりょう}した→魅了する：19016_miryousuru⟧。
examples.english: The audience was captivated by the extraordinary performance technique.

notes:
Has two distinct registers. In classical/formal usage, {超絶|ちょうぜつ} means genuinely transcendent (going beyond worldly things, as in philosophy or virtuoso music). In modern casual speech, it functions as a trendy intensifier similar to ⟦{超|ちょう}→超〜：28619_chou⟧ but stronger, meaning "insanely" or "ridiculously."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {超絶|ちょうぜつ}⟦{技巧|ぎこう}→技巧：12779_gikou⟧: transcendent technique (often for music)
- {超絶|ちょうぜつ}⟦うまい→うまい：01279_umai⟧: insanely delicious (casual)
- {超絶|ちょうぜつ}{可愛|かわい}い: ridiculously cute (casual)
- {超絶|ちょうぜつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧: transcendent, extraordinary (literary)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{超|ちょう}→超〜：28619_chou⟧: super, very (casual prefix intensifier, lighter)
- ⟦{卓越|たくえつ}→卓越：07990_takuetsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧: outstanding, preeminent (formal)
- ⟦{抜群|ばつぐん}→抜群：12783_batsugun⟧: outstanding, exceptional (common praise word)
